title: Mister International 2026 organizers issue advisory amid Bangkok flooding
summary: Organizers of the 2026 Mister International competition are not letting up despite heavy rains causing floods in Bangkok. The finale show scheduled on Saturday evening, Sept. 26, is still pushing…

blocks.text: Organizers of the 2026 Mister International competition are not letting up despite heavy rains causing floods in Bangkok. The finale show scheduled on Saturday evening, Sept. 26, is still pushing through. The Thai capital was inundated by continuous overnight rains that started to pour on Friday, Sept. 25. The volume of rainwater overwhelmed drainage systems in parts of Bangkok. “TONIGHT’S FINAL IS GOING AHEAD AS SCHEDULED,” the Mister International Organization posted on social media while sharing reminders to those who are planning to watch the show. “Due to heavy rain and flooding in parts of Bangkok, all fans and members of […]...
